bibliographic.title: With Love from Oodna
bibliographic.author: haus of sheewolf
bibliographic.description:
You are returning from a road trip from Central Australia through the South Australian outback in your Troopy (Toyota Land Cruiser Troop Carrier) with a greyhound and your partner.

Things don't go exactly to plan ... will you survive to tell the tale?

A mostly non-fiction, rich narrative with multiple endings.

Submitted to the following: Road Trip Jam 2025, Dialogue Jam, NarraScope 2025 Showcase & Women's Game Fest (Spring 2025).
